_comment: Smart Search external site profile for the Joomla Community Magazine (a Joomla site). Its sitemap lists only a few pages, so the issues are crawled through their links; new articles also come from the feed. Use with tools/add-site-task.php, or copy the params into a new 'Smart Search: index external site' task.
title: Smart Search: index magazine.joomla.org
